cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(PokerLabSolver LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(SOLVER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../texas-solver-source")
file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCES "${SOLVER}/src/*.cpp")
list(FILTER SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/(pybind|experimental)/")
list(FILTER SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/console.cpp$")
add_library(engine STATIC ${SOURCES})
target_include_directories(engine PUBLIC "${SOLVER}/include" "${SOLVER}/ext/fmt/include")
target_compile_definitions(engine PUBLIC FMT_HEADER_ONLY WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX)
target_compile_options(engine PRIVATE -O3 -fopenmp)
add_executable(console_solver "${SOLVER}/src/console.cpp")
target_link_libraries(console_solver PRIVATE engine)
target_link_options(console_solver PRIVATE -static -fopenmp)
